text.en: Pet owners consistently commend the salon staff for their welcoming demeanour and attentive customer service. Reviewers note that groomers communicate clearly before appointments and show reassuring patience when greeting both young puppies and long-standing client pets arriving for styling.

Clients report thoroughly clean coats, pleasant scents, and tidy haircuts following visits. Several reviewers mention that initial puppy grooming sessions went smoothly without mishap, leaving dogs looking neat and prompting owners to rebook regular maintenance appointments at the facility.

Reviewers express relief at how gently staff treat dogs requiring delicate handling, including blind pets and animals with chronic respiratory conditions. Clients observe that their companions return calm and uninjured from both grooming appointments and overnight boarding stays.

q.en: Does Puppy Power Dog Resort cater to elderly or disabled dogs?

a.en: Yes, pet owners describe staff successfully grooming fragile dogs, including senior pets with collapsed tracheas or blindness.

q.en: Are overnight boarding services offered at this facility?

a.en: Yes, clients mention utilising the resort for both pet grooming appointments and overnight dog boarding.

q.en: How do customers perceive the grooming rates here?

a.en: Reviewers describe the pricing as reasonable and economical compared to other local dog grooming options.
